narrative.overview:
The Antigravity SEO design system is built to command authority at both ends of the technical spectrum. It rejects the generic SaaS pattern of nested, decorative cards and endless accordion folders that force users to click through 14 siloed categories to understand site health. Instead, it fuses an executive-level strategic risk dossier with a live, actionable technical triage terminal into a single, high-craft, portable document.

Rooted in deep obsidian glass and precision instrumentation, the visual grammar draws from aerospace flight telemetry, high-frequency trading terminals, and security audit dashboards. Every data point is immediate and purposeful: leaders get immediate clarity on macro health score, industry benchmarks, and top business threats in under ten seconds, while engineering leads can instantly filter critical blockers, inspect diagnostic evidence, and copy drop-in configuration patches directly into production.

The system is completely self-contained with zero CDN calls or third-party web font dependencies, delivering instant rendering and flawless offline durability whether viewed via file://, emailed as a deliverable, or printed to PDF.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-Lens Architectural Symmetry: Simultaneous high-altitude executive briefing and granular diagnostic triage.
Instrument-Grade Telemetry: Calibrated semantic status channels (Coral, Amber, Emerald, Indigo) over obsidian slate.
Data-Dense Yet Legible: Tabular numeric alignments, monospace code terminals, and razor 1px borders avoiding visual fatigue.
Zero-Dependency Portability: Built entirely on native system fonts, inline vector SVGs, and pure vanilla CSS custom properties.

rules.name: The Semantic Status Invariant
rules.body: Coral, Amber, and Emerald are strictly reserved for operational diagnostic states (Critical, Warning, Pass). No decorative element, chart element, or layout frame may use these hues unless reporting state.

rules.name: The Ambient Contrast Rule
rules.body: Background and card surfaces must never rely on blur filters alone; a crisp 1px border (var(--card-border)) is mandatory to preserve spatial boundaries under varied monitor calibrations.

rules.name: The Tabular Alignment Rule
rules.body: All numerical readouts, scores, and issue counters must specify font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to eliminate jitter and misalignment during sorting or tab transitions.

rules.name: The Monospace Diagnostic Rule
rules.body: Any HTTP header, Schema.org type, DNS directive, canonical URL, or code patch must be rendered in var(--font-mono) with explicit line-height and syntax demarcation.

rules.name: The Sticky Command Horizon
rules.body: The top navigation header remains sticky (position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50) at all times, providing persistent access to the view switcher, audit timestamp, and export triggers regardless of scroll depth.

rules.name: The No-Reflow Transition Rule
rules.body: Tab transitions, drawer expansions, and filter operations must never animate layout dimensions (width, height) dynamically to avoid layout thrashing; transitions are strictly limited to opacity, transform, and background-color.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Fallback
rules.body: Surfaces are never defined by drop shadows alone; every surface card possesses an explicit 1px border (var(--card-border)) to ensure separation on high-brightness or low-contrast displays.

rules.name: The Neutral Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows must always be neutral black/slate alphas (rgba(0, 0, 0, ...)); colored halo glows or neon spread shadows are strictly prohibited.

dos: Do preserve 100% offline portability: all SVG icons, CSS variables, and scripts must remain inlined with zero external web requests.
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast for all text elements in both dark and light modes (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI components).
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for all telemetry counters, table numbers, and score indicators.
Do provide copy-to-clipboard functionality on all code snippets, schema markups, and configuration directives.
Do hide navigation chrome and expand all code drawers automatically when printing or exporting to PDF via @media print.
donts: Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin) during tab switches or accordion interactions; use transform and opacity only.
Don't use colored neon halo glows or saturated drop shadows (box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent)).
Don't rely on external CDN scripts, font stylesheets (Google Fonts), or external asset URLs.
Don't rely on color alone to convey status; always pair color with text badges (CRITICAL, WARNING, PASS) and numeric metrics.
Don't introduce horizontal page-level scrollbars; ensure tables and code snippets scroll internally within their own overflow containers.
